finalDecision: B. ENGINEERING VERIFIED — EXTERNAL PROVIDER ACCESS BLOCKED
executiveSummary: All software engineering, safety gates, real database persistence (PostgreSQL 16), deterministic ranking, state machines, financial controls, concurrency resilience, and security validations have been implemented, executed, and verified with 100% test pass rate (74/74 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors). Full live autonomous deployment to public environments is deliberately held pending procurement of commercial external provider credentials (IATA GDS ticketing, Stripe Issuing corporate card facility, and Meta WhatsApp verified production business account).

financialSafety.vccControls: Single-use Corporate Virtual Card with MCC 3000 (Airlines) locking
financialSafety.cardDataIsolation: Full PAN and CVV excluded from REST JSON serialization (@JsonIgnore) and masked in all audit logs
financialSafety.idempotency: Double approval / double charge blocked with zero duplicate cards
financialSafety.zeroCostOptions: Zero fare adjustment options bypass card issuance

bookingSafety.partnerFailureHandling: Airline 500 error / timeout moves case to FAILED_ESCALATED with zero invented PNRs and captures operator guidance

securityAudit.twoFactorAuth: 6-digit OTP delivered via WhatsApp with constant-time verification (MessageDigest.isEqual)
securityAudit.bruteForceProtection: 5 failed OTP attempts triggers 15-minute account lockout
securityAudit.webhookDeduplication: Message ID deduplication set prevents replay attacks

concurrencyAndLoad.raceConditionProtection: Optimistic locking (@Version) and case-scoped option resolution

stripeIssuing.blockerReason: Commercial corporate credit line and live Stripe Issuing API keys (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) require business entity underwriting.

amadeusSabreGds.blockerReason: Live NDC/GDS ticketing requires IATA/ARC certification, Pseudo City Code (PCC), and carrier bilateral commercial agreements.

metaWhatsAppCloudApi.blockerReason: Production WhatsApp Business verification and non-test phone number whitelisting require Meta Business Manager verification.
